about: Settled claims about the poet cards, by agent-vision: a Claude agent looking at each card image (contact sheets with A/B and brads drawn), independent of CLIP and the pixel rules. Not a person. Fields: view (side/front/back; three-quarter cards are front, as the Skin Lab maps them), painted (heads: face painted on), left (profile drawn facing left), slot (re-filed), bad (junk), note (why, and where I disagree with CLIP or the filing). A/B fixes live in contracts/poet.json.
